name: What are the common signs of a water heater leak?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a water heater leak?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a water heater leak include visible puddles of water around the base of the unit, dripping sounds, or rust stains on the tank or floor. You might also notice a decrease in hot water supply, strange noises coming from the water heater, or an unusual musty odor if mold has begun to form due to a hidden leak. Inspecting the pressure relief valve, drain valve, and inlet/outlet connections can often reveal the source of the leak before significant damage occurs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include puddles, drips, rust stains, decreased hot water, strange noises, or musty odors around the water heater.
